notes: Miller, ch. XII: Colonel McClure ordered the 2nd Battalion, 35th Infantry, and the 25th Cavalry Reconnaissance Troop to relieve the 132nd Infantry at the Gifu. Matches regiment claim C12921 (9 January). Commander Stanley R. Larsen (Miller, ch. IX n. 47 and the Gifu narrative). Confidence 0.5: one official family.

current_activity: clearing the last resistance out of the Gifu by nightfall
notes: Miller, ch. XII: the 35th Infantry, with the 2nd Battalion left pressing the Gifu after the Sea Horse envelopment, cleared the last resistance out of the Gifu by nightfall on 23 January 1943. Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9, independently date the complete reduction of the Gifu to 23 January. Confidence 0.7. Matches the promoted regiment claim C12924. Commander Stanley R. Larsen.
